title: Large-Message All-to-All Communication at Frontier Scale
problem: At exascale, all-to-all communication becomes latency-dominated even for large messages, making it a critical bottleneck for collective operations.
motivation: MPI_Alltoall is a fundamental communication pattern in HPC applications; vendor implementations may not be optimized for extreme scale (65K+ tasks).
method: GPU-aware MPI implementations using direct GPU memory access, optimized for two distinct message size ranges at 8192-node scale.
key_novelty: Demonstrates latency-centric optimization strategies that outperform vendor implementations at Frontier scale with 65536 tasks.
contributions: Two GPU-aware all-to-all implementations targeting different message size ranges
Performance characterization on Frontier at record scale (65536 tasks, 8192 nodes)
Guidance for MPI_Alltoall_init optimization on exascale systems
limitations: Focus on large messages; latency-dominated regime; specific to Frontier architecture.
